newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat down on pool price cut expectations.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat down on pool price cut expectations.

text.p: Australian wheat futures fell in moderate volume on Monday on trade expectations of a cut in the Australian Wheat Board's (AWB) export pool prices later in the day.
The January 1997 contract fell by A$5.00 to A$178.50 a tonne on 24 trades, while July 1997 fell by A$2.50 to A$180.00 on five trades.

Ben Suttie of C,A & L Bell Commodities said the A$215.00 a tonne pool price for new crop Australian Standard White was expected to be cut to A$210.00 or A$205.00 in the AWB announcement, due around 5.30 p.m. (0730 GMT) Monday.
"So (there's been) a slightly weaker tone," he said of Monday's Sydney Futures Exchange trading.
USDA September update production figures due out Wednesday for wheat, corn and soy products was producing a range of expectations, but generally the market looked bearish, he said.
